answer_1.quote: When conversing with a human user, an opendomain dialogue system is expected to generate human-like responses

answer_2.quote: We use ppl, response length and distinct-n to evaluate the diversity of generated responses. We also use BLEU to evaluate the degree of the word-overlap between generated responses and ground truth. Moreover, we use Embedding Average (Average) to evaluate the semantic relationship of generated responses and ground-truth responses. Finally, we introduce the coherence to assess the coherence between contexts and generated responses.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation to further evaluate our model and baseline models. Following the work of ; , we randomly extract 200 samples from the test sets of the two dialogue datasets, respectively. Each sample contains one context and the response generated by different models. Three annotators are invited to rank the generated responses with respect to three aspects: diversity, relevance and fluency.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rank the generated responses with respect to diversity, relevance, and fluency.
